scientific_scope: TRAIN-only reused development diagnostic; all 16 targets were exposed by the earlier DRUNet tail report; not fresh and not a generalization estimate

official_model.architecture: KAIR colour DRUNet UNetRes, discriminatively trained Gaussian denoiser
official_model.tile_inference: each original dirty 20x20 input tile independently; reflect-pad right/bottom by 4 to 24x24; crop exact 20x20; no cross-tile or cross-board context

matcher.view: bilateral directional_scores on independently rendered DRUNet40 tiles
matcher.baseline: bilateral directional_scores on original dirty tiles
matcher.score_semantics: both directional_scores outputs are row-normalized E14 log-probability matrices
matcher.fusion: (1-weight)*dirty_bilateral + weight*drunet40_bilateral, separately for right and down
matcher.output_pixels: always the exact corresponding original upright dirty tiles in the solved strict permutation; DRUNet-rendered pixels are matcher-only and never enter output

post_layout_evaluation.harmonizer: exact frozen RGB seam offsets then bounded luminance gains
tails: F: exact h20-derived t40 mask blending independent one-pass h28 protected pixels and h40 flat pixels
layout_metrics: right/down/mean exact adjacency under target-assisted recovered train mapping
post_layout_evaluation.pixel_metric: RGB SSIM for h28 and F final outputs

selection_rule: On first 8 only, choose among fusion weights 0.25,0.5,0.75 by maximum mean F final RGB SSIM; break ties by h28 final RGB SSIM, mean exact adjacency, translation-aligned placement, then lower weight. Pure DRUNet is diagnostic and cannot be selected.
calibration_access_rule: Do not create a calibration preregistration, decode calibration targets, or scale this matcher unless every last-8 verification gate passes. If it passes, coordinate a reused-calibration panel disjoint from active 264:384 and 408:528 reservations before freezing a new config.
target_access_order: verify checkpoint, assets, manifest and exact train roster
render DRUNet matcher-only tiles, compute every score arm, solve layouts, assemble only original tiles and freeze h28/F predictions for all 16
write and read back a content-addressed commitment
only then decode the already-exposed train targets once for selection and verification
forbidden: DRUNet pixels in raw, harmonized, h28, F, submission, or any other output image
target/reference pixels or recovered mapping during matcher inference
selecting a weight on the last 8 verification records
changing weights, selection rule, verification gate, sigma, score view, decoder, harmonizer, or tails after target access
tile substitution, duplicate use, rotation, resampling, warp, or geometry change
calibration, holdout, test, frozen edge-v1/v2, or production access before the verification gate
changes to frozen v1/v2/production files or ZIP
